plugin.name: RetreatFnSucks
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: re/rw/rn/rs/ru/rd retreat in one direction and keep retrying it on every failure

muclient.script:
-- ===================================================================== -- Colours (user's standard theme) -- x099 brackets / x045 name / W message / x048 highlight -- ===================================================================== local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048
local TAG = "RetreatFnSucks"
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
-- [RetreatFnSucks] <msg><HI hi><tail> local function echoHi (msg, hi, tail) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg, CLR_HI, "", hi, CLR_MSG, "", tail or "") end
local function helpLine (left, right) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-10s", left), CLR_MSG, "", right) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Configuration -- ===================================================================== local COMBAT_STATE = 8 -- char.status "state": fighting
-- An attempt only stays live while the MUD is still answering us. Each fail -- line refreshes it; if nothing happens for this long we assume the fight is -- long over and stop retrying on a stale direction. local STALE_SECS = 60
-- How many directions can be stacked up: the leg we are doing now plus two -- behind it. Picking one more than this cancels the lot. local QUEUE_MAX = 3
-- After a retreat lands we wait for the next char.status to say whether the -- mob in the new room has us fighting again. It arrives with the next prompt; -- this is only a fail-safe in case one never does. local VERDICT_SECS = 5
-- Combat breaking ends the queue - but the room change for the retreat that -- broke it can reach us a moment later than the status that reports it, so -- give the move this long to show up before dropping everything. local GRACE_SECS = 2
local DIRS = { e = "east", w = "west", n = "north", s = "south", u = "up", d = "down", }
-- ===================================================================== -- State -- ===================================================================== local gEnabled = true -- reton / retoff / ret local gSilent = false -- retsilent: hide the per-retry "Retreat failed" line local gQueue = {} -- stacked directions; [1] is the one we are doing now local gWaiting = false -- retreat landed; [1] is held until the next -- char.status says whether we are still fighting local gLast = 0 -- os.time () of the last retreat we sent local gTries = 0 -- retreats sent for gQueue[1] local gVnum = nil -- last room.info vnum seen local gState = nil -- last char.status "state" seen (nil = not seen yet) local gEndedAt = nil -- os.time () the fight ended without us moving local gWalked = false -- the leg in flight is a plain walk, not a retreat
-- Everything is off: moved on, fight over, cancelled, or plugin off. local function clearQueue () gQueue = {} gWaiting = false gTries = 0 gLast = 0 gEndedAt = nil gWalked = false end
-- Drop the queue once it can no longer mean anything. Called before we read -- it, so no timer is needed: char.status arrives with the prompt constantly. local function sweep () if #gQueue == 0 then return end local now = os.time () if now - gLast > STALE_SECS then clearQueue () return end if gWaiting then -- No verdict ever arrived; assume the fight is over. if now - gLast > VERDICT_SECS then clearQueue () end elseif gEndedAt and now - gEndedAt > GRACE_SECS then -- The fight ended and we never moved: the retreat is moot. clearQueue () end end
local function queueLive () sweep () return #gQueue > 0 end
-- Out of combat the aliases are plain shortcuts: the retreat still goes to -- the MUD, but no attempt is armed - there is nothing to retry, and nothing -- to conflict with the next direction you pick in a real fight. gState is -- nil only before the first char.status of the session. local function inCombat () return gState == nil or gState == COMBAT_STATE end
local function sendRetreat () gTries = gTries + 1 gWaiting = false gWalked = false gLast = os.time () Send ("retreat " .. gQueue[1]) end
-- Nothing is on us, so there is nothing to retreat from: walk this leg -- instead. It stays at the front of the queue until the room change says it -- landed, exactly like a retreat does. local function walkNext () gWaiting = false gWalked = true gEndedAt = nil gTries = 0 gLast = os.time () local dir = gQueue[1] Send (dir) if not gSilent then echoHi ("Nothing on us - walking ", dir, " instead.") end end
-- The retreat worked. Drop it off the front and hold whatever was stacked -- behind it until the next char.status: still fighting (the mob in the new -- room is on us) means we retreat again, an empty room means we walk it. -- -- We wait for that fresh reading rather than trusting the last char.status we -- saw, because room.info can reach us before the status that reports the -- fight ending - acting on the stale "still fighting" would fire a retreat -- into an empty room. char.status carries enemypct, so it is re-sent every -- round of a fight: the wait is a prompt, not a pause. local function advanceQueue () -- We already know the room is clear if combat had broken before this move -- arrived, or if the leg that just landed was a walk and nothing has -- engaged us since - no need to wait for a verdict in either case. local landedClear = gEndedAt ~= nil or (gWalked and gState ~= COMBAT_STATE)
table.remove (gQueue, 1) gTries = 0 gEndedAt = nil
if #gQueue == 0 then clearQueue () return end
if landedClear then walkNext () return end
gWaiting = true gLast = os.time () end
-- ===================================================================== -- Alias callbacks -- =====================================================================
-- re / rw / rn / rs / ru / rd function RetreatDir (letter) local dir = DIRS[string.lower (letter or "")] if not dir then return end
-- A queued direction still counts as live while it waits for the next -- fight, so pick the queue up before deciding what this keypress means. local live = queueLive ()
-- Plugin off, or not fighting with nothing stacked up: send it, but don't -- arm a retry. if not gEnabled or (not inCombat () and not live) then clearQueue () Send ("retreat " .. dir) return end
-- The stack is full and here comes one more: cancel the lot. if #gQueue >= QUEUE_MAX then clearQueue () echo ("Conflicting Messages: Make Up Your Mind.") return end
table.insert (gQueue, dir)
if #gQueue == 1 then gTries = 0 sendRetreat () elseif not gSilent then echoHi ("Queued: ", dir, " once the current retreat lands.") end end
function RetreatSetOn (on) gEnabled = on and true or false if not gEnabled then clearQueue () end SetVariable ("enabled", gEnabled and "1" or "0") if gEnabled then echoHi ("Auto-retry is ", "ON", " - a failed retreat repeats the same direction.") else echoHi ("Auto-retry is ", "OFF", " - re/rw/rn/rs/ru/rd still send one retreat.") end end
function RetreatToggle () RetreatSetOn (not gEnabled) end
-- retsilent: hide/show the per-retry line. Status, conflict and help -- messages still print either way. function RetreatToggleSilent () gSilent = not gSilent SetVariable ("silent", gSilent and "1" or "0") if gSilent then echoHi ("Retry messages are ", "OFF", " - retrying quietly.") else echoHi ("Retry messages are ", "ON", " - each retry prints a line.") end end
function RetreatHelp () echo ("Retreat, and keep retreating, in one direction.") helpLine ("re rw rn", "retreat east / west / north") helpLine ("rs ru rd", "retreat south / up / down") helpLine ("reton", "turn auto-retry on") helpLine ("retoff", "turn auto-retry off") helpLine ("ret", "toggle auto-retry") helpLine ("retsilent", "toggle the per-retry message") helpLine ("ret help", "this screen") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Every ", CLR_HI, "", "You FAIL to retreat!", CLR_MSG, "", " sends the same direction again, as many") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " times as it takes.") -- The direction stack is deliberately undocumented here. sweep () local q = "" if #gQueue > 0 and not gWaiting then q = gWalked and (", walking " .. gQueue[1]) or (", retreating " .. gQueue[1]) end echoHi ("Currently ", gEnabled and "ON" or "OFF", q .. (gSilent and ", retry messages off." or ".")) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Trigger callback: "You FAIL to retreat!" -- ===================================================================== function RetreatFailed () if not gEnabled then return end if not queueLive () then return end local dir = gQueue[1] sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Retreat failed - going ", dir, " again (try " .. gTries .. ").") end end
-- ===================================================================== -- GMCP (telnet option 201) - advance or end the queue as the fight resolves -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (theType, data) if theType ~= 201 then return end
local message = string.match (data, "^([%w%.%-_]+)") if not message then return end message = string.lower (message)
-- Moved rooms: the retreat worked (or something else moved us). Whatever -- was stacked behind it is next. if message == "room.info" then local vnum = string.match (data, '"num"%s*:%s*"?(%-?%d+)"?') if vnum and vnum ~= gVnum then gVnum = vnum if #gQueue > 0 then advanceQueue () end end return end
if message == "char.status" then local st = tonumber (string.match (data, '"state"%s*:%s*(%d+)') or "") if not st then return end gState = st
if st == COMBAT_STATE then gEndedAt = nil -- Still fighting after the retreat landed: the mob in the new room has -- us, which is exactly what the stacked direction was for. Go. if gWaiting and gEnabled and queueLive () then local dir = gQueue[1] sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Retreat landed - now going ", dir, ".") end
-- Something engaged us on a leg we were walking. A plain move will not -- get out of a fight, so redo that leg as a retreat. elseif gWalked and gEnabled and queueLive () then local dir = gQueue[1] sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Caught in a fight - retreating ", dir, " instead.") end end else -- Combat broke. If we had just landed, the room is empty: walk the -- next leg rather than retreating it. If we never moved at all, the -- retreat is moot - the grace below only covers the room change for -- THIS retreat arriving a beat late. if gWaiting then if gEnabled and queueLive () then walkNext () else clearQueue () end else if #gQueue > 0 and not gEndedAt then gEndedAt = os.time () end sweep () end end end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Housekeeping -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginInstall () gEnabled = GetVariable ("enabled") ~= "0" gSilent = GetVariable ("silent") == "1" clearQueue () end
function OnPluginSaveState () SetVariable ("enabled", gEnabled and "1" or "0") SetVariable ("silent", gSilent and "1" or "0") end
